message:
Added mass alone cannot move the bridge out of the walking band, so tuned push-back must do the work, Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead and Bridge Retrofit Engineer.

In plain words dead weight barely drops frequency while the tuned damper cuts response by damping. The locked-frequency check (E69) gives 1.86 Hz with 800 kg locked versus 1.90 Hz bare, only 2.10 percent down and still inside the 1.25 to 2.3 Hz critical range, while the free-decay simulation (E17) gives about 6.20 percent effective damping with tuned action versus near zero bare.

Tuning is tight but survivable if mass ratio is kept near 4 percent and stops clear the stroke, Manager.

In plain words a small mistune still holds Medium comfort but cutting mass to save weight grows travel fast. Tuned Mass Damper, defined as Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), total 800 kg is 4.00 percent ratio from the total-mass calculation (E13), optimum tune 1.83 Hz from the optimum-frequency calculation (E14) at 12.0 percent damper damping from the optimum-damping calculation (E15) with 49.4 mm peak travel from the free-decay simulation (E17) fitting a hand width, and the detuning sweep (E70) holds 0.476 to 0.526 m/s2 at plus or minus 5.00 percent mistune, inside 0.5 to 1.0 m/s2 Medium and about 0.05 times gravity, a small fraction of body weight.

I confirm from dynamics what Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead takes from the A Review on Comfort of Pedestrian Bridges Under Human-Induced Vibrations and Tuned Mass Damper Control Technologies - PMC (E48), that spaced Multiple Tuned Mass Damper, defined as Multiple Tuned Mass Damper (MTMD), tunes ride out drift, which is why twin 400 kg units detuned apart about 1.83 Hz are more robust than one exact unit, and I add for verify-comfort-acceptance the concert-hall decay analogy (C31) where Reverberation Time 60 dB, defined as Reverberation Time 60 dB (RT60), maps to log-decrement damping: pluck the bridge locked then unlocked and pass on measured effective damping, not only on calculation.

My position is ready, because mass-shift versus damping tradeoff, tight-tune with stroke clearance, and twin-detuned robustness close my domain on proposal v1.
